description.value: Hungry Zus is a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant in downtown Vancouver's Financial District, serving bowls, pita wraps, falafel, grilled meats, and house-made sides with a strong emphasis on fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Located on Granville Street steps from Waterfront SkyTrain Station, it offers indoor dining and a summer outdoor patio. The restaurant runs a loyalty rewards program and offers customizable catering for groups.
